what: Time to a relative-L2 target of the pre-registered end-to-end suites (13 JAX problems, 2 PyTorch Poisson problems): the strongest omnibias pair (Adam or L-BFGS with the projected or omnibias engine, Gauss-Newton, ENGD or KFAC with the structured Gram) against the strongest baseline pair (jet, folx, dense, nested autodiff, Hutchinson, STDE, SDGD, jet_collapsed with Adam, L-BFGS, Gauss-Newton or ENGD), per target and per treatment of the compile time
hardware: one exclusive NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, float64, three seeds per pair
protocol: ratio = baseline time / omnibias time, geometric mean over three seeds; lower = exp(mean log r - t(0.95, 2) sd / sqrt 3), upper = ratio^2 / lower; both pairs are the lowest-median pairs among those that reached the target in every seed, selected on the seeds that are compared (which favours the baseline when the choice is noisy); a target that no pair reached in every seed is incomplete, not a ratio
